title: TV shows no signal
shortDescription: Fire TV Stick or Cube powered but no video on TV.
fullDescription: Fire TV Stick boots but TV shows no signal. Often caused by inadequate USB power (use included adapter, not TV USB port) or HDMI issues.

causes.cause: Powered from TV USB (not enough current)

symptoms: Blue LED but no TV output

fixSteps.title: Use included AC adapter
fixSteps.instruction: TV USB ports often can't supply enough power.

fixSteps.title: Use HDMI extender
fixSteps.instruction: Fire TV ships with extender that relieves strain on HDMI port.

videoSearchQuery: Fire TV Stick no signal fix

faq.q: Can I power from TV USB?
faq.a: Only if it supplies 1A+; newer Fire TVs need more.

title: Alexa Voice Remote not pairing
shortDescription: Remote unresponsive; cannot pair with Fire TV.
fullDescription: Fire TV remote uses Bluetooth. Dead batteries or pairing conflicts prevent pairing.

faq.a: Hold Left + Menu + Back for 10 seconds.

title: Constant buffering during playback
fullDescription: Common on Fire TV Stick Lite with weak WiFi signal. Older sticks also have slower CPU that can't handle 4K HDR streams consistently.

fixSteps.title: Ethernet adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Fire TV Cube has Ethernet; Stick uses $15 adapter.

faq.q: Does Fire TV Cube have Ethernet?

title: Software update failed
shortDescription: Fire OS update could not install.
fullDescription: Update fails on Fire TV Stick usually because of low internal storage. Clear cache and uninstall unused apps.

fixSteps.title: Clear app caches
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Applications > Manage Installed > Clear cache.

faq.q: How much storage do I need?

title: HDCP unauthorized error
shortDescription: Content blocked due to HDCP failure.
fullDescription: Fire TV cannot establish HDCP 2.2 with TV/AVR. Swap cable or bypass receiver.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle chain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV, AVR, Fire TV 60 sec.

title: Fire TV overheating
shortDescription: Device hot to touch; performance degrades.
fullDescription: Fire TV Stick 4K tucked behind TV can overheat. Cube gets warm during 4K HDR decode.

fixSteps.title: Use HDMI extender
fixSteps.instruction: Move stick away from hot TV.

title: Alexa voice control unresponsive
shortDescription: Alexa button on remote does nothing.
fullDescription: Remote mic may be dirty, network may be down, or Alexa services blocked by pihole/content filter.

fixSteps.title: Clean remote mic hole
fixSteps.instruction: Small brush near top of remote.

videoSearchQuery: Fire TV Alexa button not working

faq.a: Possibly - check block list for amazon-adsystem or similar.

title: Black screen after boot
shortDescription: Fire TV boots but no picture.
fullDescription: Resolution mismatch or HDMI issue. Force safe resolution via remote sequence.

fixSteps.title: Force display mode
fixSteps.instruction: During boot, hold Up + Rewind to cycle resolutions.

faq.a: Yes for Fire TV - no filesystem damage risk.

title: App closes unexpectedly
fullDescription: Fire OS apps sometimes crash after updates. Clear cache and data or reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Applications > Manage Installed > Clear cache.

faq.a: Data clears login, cache keeps login.

title: WiFi drops repeatedly
fullDescription: Fire TV WiFi performance is weaker than Apple TV. Forget network and re-add, or move closer to router.

faq.q: Does Fire TV Cube have WiFi 6?
